top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Rattled by Tech Selloff, Oil Drops: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian equities retreated as technology shares plunged at the start of a packed week that could help set the near-term direction for the artificial intelligence trade. Oil fell.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: EQT Sees “Wave” of Take-Private Opportunities in Japan
top_signals.summary: Jean Eric Salata, Chair at EQT Group, says the Stockholm-based private equity firm plans to invest up to 30 percent of its $30 billion in dry powder in Japan. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
